overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals granted variance requests for fencing at 22 Alston Street and a covered porch addition at 17 Green Road. The board also voted to continue hearings on three other property matters to its next regular meeting.

items.title: 590 Boston Avenue
items.summary: The board approved a continuance to July 13, 2023, while the applicant addresses site plan modifications with the Community Development Board.

items.title: 36 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: The board granted a continuance to the July 13 meeting to allow the applicant time to coordinate fence details with the police chief.

items.title: 396 Main Street
items.summary: The board voted to continue the bakery variance application to the next regular meeting to cure procedural defects.

items.title: 22 Alston Street
items.summary: The board approved a variance allowing the Medford Housing Authority to install a 10-foot chain-link privacy fence adjacent to a commercial construction yard.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The board reviewed upcoming zoning ordinance cleanup items with city staff and approved the meeting minutes from April 27, 2023.

items.title: 17 Green Road
items.summary: The board approved a front setback variance to allow construction of an addition and covered porch matching the historical character of the dwelling.
